Downloaded on 24 September 2026 by the independent check at 19:29:10Z-19:29:16Z and 19:39:23Z-19:39:29Z (cache-busting query); by this packet at 20:21:16Z, 20:41:44Z (cache-busting query) and 20:55:44Z, each time with the same byte count and SHA-256; at least two downloads were 30 minutes or more apart. Bytes and SHA-256 are of the identity-encoded body, requested without Accept-Encoding (the Diet API and the Internet Archive send gzip when a client asks for it, which changes the transferred bytes but not the content). This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the same committee on 6 July 1994, member 藤田スミ tells the minister that on television Prime Minister Murayama (村山総理) had cited the gap between domestic and foreign prices.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-12 only. Each House's designation vote, any joint committee and the House of Representatives' prevailing resolution, the Imperial appointment ceremony, Kantei statements and accounts, a cabinet's formation, its resignation en masse, any continued performance of duties and acting service stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this role in this packet: an unnamed statement, agenda or ceremony record, an acting prime minister, the House of Councillors' 1998 designee or the successor at the closing boundary. Ministers, deputy prime ministers and party offices are excluded.
